summary.text: Meredith Lawson‐Rowe is a Democratic state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 5 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. An executive administrative assistant, she previously served on the Reynoldsburg City Council.

paragraphs.text: Lawson‐Rowe’s career experience includes working as an executive administrative assistant, and she served on the Reynoldsburg City Council, according to Ballotpedia.
In the 2025–2026 session she was assigned to the Community Revitalization, Local Government, and Veterans and Military Development committees.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
